stock.description: Ching Lee Holdings Limited operates primarily as an investment holding firm, providing construction, consulting, and project management services across Hong Kong. Its operational scope includes a variety of building endeavors, specifically foundational substructure construction, above-ground superstructure development, alongside repair, upkeep, modification, and expansion projects. The company also actively participates in property asset management. Established in 1998, its main office is located in Jordan, Hong Kong. Ching Lee Holdings Limited functions as a subsidiary of JT Glory Limited.
